subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep #41372 open as a broad field-report umbrella, split the remaining slices into owner-scoped issues, or close it after linking the active canonical follow-ups?
rationale: The report spans config recovery, channel delivery, cron, web_search, onboarding auth, resource policy, and update handoff, and current evidence supports partial fixes plus active canonical follow-ups rather than one deterministic close or one safe repair PR.

options.title: Split And Retire Umbrella
options.body: Link #85695, #100072, #55792, and any new narrow resource/web-search follow-up, then close #41372 as routed once maintainers are satisfied every slice has an owner.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave #41372 open as a manual tracking issue while the config and inbound-message product decisions remain active.

options.title: Close As Partially Superseded
options.body: Close #41372 now with a comment pointing users to the canonical open issues and current docs, accepting that lower-priority slices may need new reports later.

recommendation.title: Split And Retire Umbrella
recommendation.body: Link #85695, #100072, #55792, and any new narrow resource/web-search follow-up, then close #41372 as routed once maintainers are satisfied every slice has an owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The live history shows recent broad docs, Discord, cron, and config-recovery work across the surfaces that need routing rather than one code owner choice.
